description: Defines classes and templates for handling frames and data serialization, including fixed-size integer classes (SInt24, UInt24), frame buffer management (FrameType), and serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: SInt24
classes.description: Represents a 24-bit signed integer with serialization support.

classes.name: UInt24
classes.description: Represents a 24-bit unsigned integer with serialization support.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: Template class for managing a frame buffer with serialization/deserialization methods, supporting different block sizes and endianness.

methods.name: RealSize
methods.description: Template function to determine the real size of a type or class based on static constexpr SizeOf or sizeof.
